stage: metadata-only selection before fresh image access or outcome evaluation
policy: random permutation of source blocks of 64; published filter and source exclusions; omit every previously seen source group; retain first 4096 eligible particles, sort source indices

source_groups.identity_validation: Joined by original source stack path and zero-based image index, not by row order.

source_exclusions.reason: The source file served by EMPIAR is truncated: its MRC header declares 113 float32 particles of 360 by 360 pixels, but the HTTP Content-Range reports a total file length of 4096 bytes.
source_exclusions.recovery: Exclude this source before selection, then continue the original seeded block-order procedure until 8192 usable particles are selected. Remap verified images by original source particle identity.
